rules: Use Design System 2.0 for any user-visible SEO surface.
Write useful destination-specific editorial copy for approved SEO pages; do not generate filler text for URL volume.
Separate stable editorial facts from volatile offer/price facts; volatile facts must come from approved fresh data snapshots.
Do not invent commercial claims, guarantees, contacts, prices, reviews, ratings, or availability.
Live offer/price facts must come from an approved factual source.
Do not mass-publish thin parameter combinations merely to increase URL count.
Prefer canonical coherent landing families over crawlable faceted-search explosions.
Every publishable page must have a distinct search intent, useful copy, stable internal links, and a factual search handoff.
